parameters.name: OrderDetails
parameters.description: An array of objects, each containing the details for an order.

sub_parameters.name: ChargeType
sub_parameters.description:
The billing method for Apsara File Storage NAS. Valid values:

- `PrePaid`: subscription. This billing method is not currently supported.

- `PostPaid`: pay-as-you-go.

sub_parameters.name: FileSystemName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the file system. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

sub_parameters.name: MountTargetDomain
sub_parameters.description: The name of the mount target. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain only letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

sub_parameters.name: NetworkId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

sub_parameters.name: OrderType
sub_parameters.description: The order type. The only valid value is `BUY` (purchase).

sub_parameters.name: ProtocolType
sub_parameters.description: The storage protocol. The only valid value is `nfs`.

sub_parameters.name: StorgeType
sub_parameters.description:
The storage type. Valid values:

- `capacity`: Capacity

- `Performance`: Performance
